units.title: Adopt the accepted Codex event receipt in Agent Ecology 3
units.objective: Bind Agent Ecology 3 to the accepted shared-client revision and prove its MCP-free provider-free Luna gate can observe intrinsic Codex events.

included: Exact accepted llm_client revision binding
Provider-free public codex_events custody probe
Focused Luna preflight and fail-closed boundary tests
Regenerated provider-free evidence and Plan 10 status

outputs: Passing Agent Ecology 3 provider-free event-custody preflight
Exact accepted llm_client revision evidence at Agent Ecology 3 merge 7410b4821607a1b82959d9f515bbf335ca988627
Truthful Plan 10 transition to recovery-fixture work

acceptance.criterion: The provider-free preflight observes command_execution, file_change, and web_search fixture items through result.codex_events at the accepted shared revision and passes.
evidence_required: Exact shared-client merge revision
Provider-free preflight JSON and manifest
Focused public-consumer test
acceptance.negative_control: A result type without public codex_events still fails before budget reservation or provider dispatch.

units.title: Make the one-call Luna boundary truthful and fail closed
units.objective: Ensure the production Luna syscall binds the exact reviewed shared-client source, settles every returned result truthfully, retains ambiguous attempts, and rejects unclassified Codex events before any live canary.

included: Exact accepted llm_client revision preflight
Synchronous and asynchronous Luna settlement accounting
Dispatch-ambiguous Luna attempt accounting
Fail-closed Codex completed-item allowlist
Focused provider-free production-consumer tests

outputs: Production Luna preflight bound to the exact reviewed llm_client revision
Truthful provider_settled_rejected and dispatch_ambiguous syscall receipts at Agent Ecology 3 merge 1ac43ad685418e0a5230e935d11d890b7a6c6f0d
Provider-free focused evidence for both production syscall entrypoints

acceptance.criterion: A field-compatible but unreviewed llm_client revision fails before Luna resource reservation and dispatch.
evidence_required: Focused dependency-mismatch test
Exact expected and observed source revisions
acceptance.negative_control: The exact accepted revision with the public codex_events field passes preflight.

acceptance.criterion: Returned-but-rejected and dispatch-ambiguous Luna attempts remain unsuccessful, consume their reserved call, retain truthful resource accounting, and do not retry.
evidence_required: Focused sync and async production-consumer tests
Inspectable syscall receipts and resource deltas
acceptance.negative_control: A pre-dispatch dependency failure reserves no resources and records no provider attempt.

acceptance.criterion: Only reviewed passive Codex completed-item types pass; active, missing, and unclassified types fail closed after truthful settlement.
evidence_required: Focused passive/active/unknown event fixtures
Ordered event types in the rejection receipt
acceptance.negative_control: A result containing only reasoning and agent_message events remains eligible for action validation.

units.title: Execute the authorized one-call Luna Medium canary
units.objective: Add the explicit live acknowledgement boundary, dispatch exactly one representative Luna Medium production-path call, and retain a terminal passing or blocked receipt without retry or fallback.

included: Exact one-call acknowledgement gate
Provider-free negative test proving live dispatch is inaccessible without acknowledgement
One authentic codex/gpt-5.6-luna call through the production prompt, schema, settlement, and action path
Durable route, trace, usage, timing, billing, event, action, and custody receipt
Truthful Plan 10 Slice C status
excluded: Retry, semantic repair, or fallback call
Prompt or schema tuning after dispatch
Recoverable multi-call cell or detached worker
Evaluation 07, Evaluation 08, Plan 11, or package publication

outputs: Frozen, pushed Agent Ecology 3 canary source revision d65b46e0884c98574cd9fd13355c6bd74377e276
Passing one-dispatch Luna Medium receipt at docs/evaluations/evidence/plan10_luna_recovery_gate/live_canary.json
Plan 10 status selecting conditional recovery and detached dashboard-visible PoC work

dependencies.rationale: The authentic call may begin only after exact dependency binding, truthful settlement, and fail-closed event custody are accepted.

acceptance.criterion: The live entry point refuses to cross the shared-client boundary unless the operator supplies the exact one-call acknowledgement.
evidence_required: Focused provider-free acknowledgement test
Single public live entry point with fail-closed default
acceptance.negative_control: Omitting or altering the acknowledgement produces zero provider dispatches.

acceptance.criterion: Exactly one authentic call either passes every frozen route, schema, event, action, accounting, and custody gate or retains a terminal blocked receipt naming the failed boundary.
evidence_required: Pushed pre-dispatch Agent Ecology 3 source revision
Exact llm_client revision
Trace identity, timing, usage, billing, ordered Codex events, settlement, action, and custody evidence
Provider dispatch count of exactly one
acceptance.negative_control: Any failure permits no retry, repair, fallback, or route switch.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Current user request plus Agent Ecology 3 repository authority, with one active canonical claim

units.title: Run a recoverable detached Luna PoC through the existing dashboard
units.objective: Extend the normal Agent Ecology loop with fail-closed attempt recovery and a detached lifecycle, expose that lifecycle through the existing dashboard, and retain one bounded authentic Luna Medium PoC receipt.

included: Typed append-safe attempt and checkpoint custody with stable run and attempt identities
Provider-free recovery after settlement and before local commit without a replacement dispatch
Fail-closed terminal handling for ambiguous dispatch, action application interruption, and corrupt custody
Detached start, status, pause, resume, stop, and restart around the normal Agent Ecology loop
Existing dashboard journey for live status, recent actions and events, budget state, and controls
One operator-authorized two-attempt codex/gpt-5.6-luna medium PoC with no retry, repair, fallback, or MCP server
excluded: Evaluation 07 or Evaluation 08 mutation or execution
Dashboard redesign, WebSocket or SSE infrastructure, or a generic daemon
Multi-model routing, fallback transports, prompt tuning, or MCP bridge changes
Production deployment, release, publication, or generalized hardening

outputs: Recoverable Luna attempt and checkpoint implementation on the normal Agent Ecology execution path
Detached worker lifecycle observable and controllable through the existing dashboard
Provider-free recovery, corruption, ambiguity, launcher-exit, and dashboard-control evidence
Bounded authentic two-attempt Luna Medium PoC receipt and operator journey

dependencies.rationale: The multi-attempt PoC may begin only after the exact one-call route and settlement receipt is accepted.

acceptance.criterion: A 16-attempt provider-free fixture terminated after attempt 8 settlement restarts to exactly 16 committed attempts and exactly 16 provider dispatches.
evidence_required: Focused recovery test and durable checkpoint receipt
Stable run and attempt identities across restart
Dispatch and committed-attempt counts
acceptance.negative_control: Ambiguous dispatch, interrupted action application, or corrupt custody terminates invalid and permits no replacement provider call.

acceptance.criterion: After launcher exit, a new operator process can identify the stable run, last committed attempt, current or terminal state, and exact available pause, resume, stop, or restart action.
evidence_required: Detached lifecycle integration test
Durable launch, heartbeat, status, and exit receipts
acceptance.negative_control: A missing or stale worker is reported explicitly rather than appearing healthy.

acceptance.criterion: The existing dashboard directly loads the PoC state, actions and events, budget, and stable run identity, and its pause, resume, and stop controls affect the detached run.
evidence_required: Fresh-browser critical-path observation
Dashboard API and control integration tests
Console, failed-request, and backend-log inspection
acceptance.negative_control: Direct refresh while paused or terminal preserves the run identity and reviewable evidence.

acceptance.criterion: Exactly two operator-authorized Luna Medium attempts complete through the frozen route with durable receipts, no duplicate dispatch, and no retry, repair, fallback, or MCP server.
evidence_required: Pushed pre-dispatch Agent Ecology 3 source revision
Exact shared-client revision and per-attempt stable traces
Route, timing, usage, billing, event, action, settlement, and custody evidence
acceptance.negative_control: Any provider or custody uncertainty stops the run and suppresses all later attempts.

claim_policy.eligibility_rule: Current user request plus Agent Ecology 3 repository authority, with one active canonical claim
